ဒေါသ မထားရ။
ဇာနည် ရဲဘော်
တော်ပါပေသည်။
ဇော်က ကနေသည်။
ရယ်ရယ် မောမော
ဒေါ်ဒေါ် ဘယ်ကလာသလဲ။
အဖော် ခေါ်လာသည်။
ဩဇာသီး ပါ၏။
Offer oil lamps.
The venerable monk preaches.
Do not be angry.
Say Sadhu (Amen).
The heroic soldier
Is a talented, respected person
He has a companion.
He is indeed worthy.
Zaw is dancing.
Arch your back.
Laughing joyfully
Lightly and easily
Are you very tired?
Auntie, where did you come from?
Did you come early?
She brought a companion.
There is custard apple.
ဒေါ်ဒေါ်က ဘယ်အချိန် (ဘယ်အခါ) မှာ လာသလဲ။  --- စောစော လာသလား
ဘယ်သူက တရားဟောတာလဲ။  --- ဆရာတော်
ဇာနည်က ဘယ်သူလဲ။  --- ရဲဘော်
ဘာ အက ကနေတာလဲ။  --- ဇော်က
ဘယ်သူ ဘယ်ကလာသလဲလို့ မေးနေတာလဲ။  --- ဒေါ်ဒေါ်
ဆရာတော်က ဘာလုပ်နေသလဲ။  --- တရားဟော၏
ဇော်က ဘာလုပ်နေသလဲ။  --- ကနေသည်
ဆရာတော် တရား‌ဟောပြီးရင် ဘာလုပ်ရမလဲ။  --- သာဓု ခေါ်ပါ
စိတ်ထဲမှာ ဘာမထားရဘူးလဲ။  --- ဒေါသ
ဘာအသီး ပါလာသလဲ။  --- ဩဇာသီး
What time does Auntie come? --- Did she come early?
Who is preaching the sermon? --- The Sayadaw (revered monk).
Who is Zarni? --- A soldier / comrade.
What kind of dance is being performed? --- Zaw dance.
Who is being asked where they came from? --- Auntie.
Whom did Auntie bring along? --- A companion.
What is the Sayadaw doing? --- Preaching a sermon.
What is Zaw doing? --- Dancing.
What should you do after the Sayadaw finishes preaching? --- Say "Sadhu" (Well done).
How should you hold your back? --- Keep your back straight.
In what way are you tired? --- Are you quite tired?
What should be offered as worship? --- Oil lamps.
What should not be kept in mind? --- Anger.
What fruit was brought along? --- Custard apple.
